themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can independently perform research tasks, make decisions, and execute actions within research workflows.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries, providing key insights.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Encompasses AI tools that help developers write, debug, and optimize code, accelerating the software development lifecycle.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Highlights AI-powered platforms and software designed to assist researchers in various stages of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Focuses on AI-generated user personas or data that mimic real user behavior for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Covers AI applications specifically aimed at aiding product managers in tasks like prioritization, strategy, and roadmap development.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Deals with AI's capability to analyze text or speech to gauge emotional tone, opinions, and overall sentiment from users.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Involves comparisons and reviews of different AI tools and platforms available for research and analytical tasks.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores the use of AI in automating or enhancing the process of testing the usability of products and interfaces.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is applied to inform and enhance the design process, from ideation to the creation of user interfaces.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
